sessions.title: Seed, positions API, and table
sessions.goal: Create schema and seed, expose positions via API, and render them in a table.

criteria.check: GET /api/positions returns 200 with a JSON array of Position including symbol, shares, priceCents and targetWeight
sc-dashboard renders one row per position with data-testid 'pos-row-<SYMBOL>'
sc-dashboard shows current weight as a percentage in cell data-testid 'pos-weight-<SYMBOL>'

cuts.hint: Put every position with symbol, name, shares, priceCents and targetWeight into `body` and set `status` to 200
Build `rows` so it renders one <tr> per position with data-testid `pos-row-${symbol}` and cells for symbol, shares, price and target weight
Compute `weightText` for a row as the current weight percentage to one decimal place (e.g. '12.3%') and render it in the cell with data-testid `pos-weight-${symbol}`

sessions.title: Allocation report and drift highlight
sessions.goal: Compute weights and drift and expose them via an API; highlight over/under-weight rows.

criteria.check: GET /api/allocation returns 200 with a JSON array whose items include symbol, currentWeight, targetWeight and driftPercent (positive for overweight, negative for underweight)
sc-dashboard shows an 'OVER' badge (data-testid 'drift-<SYMBOL>') for at least one overweight symbol
sc-dashboard shows an 'UNDER' badge (data-testid 'drift-<SYMBOL>') for at least one underweight symbol
While the allocation report is loading, the page shows the text 'Loading...'
GET /api/allocation returns 200 and the sum of all currentWeight values across items equals 1.000 when rounded to three decimal places

cuts.hint: Build `weights` as an array of {symbol, valueCents, currentWeight, targetWeight, driftPercent} by dividing each position's value by the portfolio total and subtracting the target weight
Put every allocation row computed from the store into `body` and set `status` to 200
Load the allocation report into `report` and render a visible 'Loading...' text while `report` is undefined
Set `driftClass`/label on each row so overweight shows a badge with text 'OVER' and underweight shows 'UNDER' at data-testid `drift-${symbol}`

sessions.title: Trade plan under budget
sessions.goal: Generate a deterministic integer-share trade plan given a budget, and show it.

criteria.check: POST /api/trade-plan with {budgetCents} returns 200 with a JSON array whose items include symbol and an integer shares field
POST /api/trade-plan with {budgetCents} returns 200 and the sum of costCents across BUY items is less than or equal to budgetCents
POST /api/trade-plan with {budgetCents} returns 200 and the first plan item's symbol corresponds to the candidate with the largest absolute positive drift
sc-dashboard renders one row per plan item with data-testid 'plan-row-<SYMBOL>'

cuts.hint: Build `ranked` as symbols ordered by absolute drift descending, breaking ties by symbol ascending to be deterministic
Build `plan` by allocating integer share quantities that reduce drift, not exceeding `budgetCents`, and computing costCents per item from priceCents
Read `budgetCents` from the request, generate the plan, write it into `body` and set `status` to 200
Map the computed plan into `planRows` with data-testid `plan-row-${symbol}` and cells for side, shares and cost

sessions.title: What‑if: edit targets and budget, persist and recompute
sessions.goal: Allow editing target weights and budget, persist them, and recompute the plan.

criteria.check: PUT /api/targets with a changed {symbol, weight} returns 200
PUT /api/settings with a changed {budgetCents} returns 200
After editing a target weight and clicking save, sc-dashboard renders a different shares value for that symbol in the plan table
Clicking save with no changes shows a visible 'Saved' notice and does not change the plan rows

cuts.hint: Upsert incoming target weights and set `status` to 200
Persist the incoming `budgetCents` setting and set `status` to 200
Keep edited weights in `targetsState` per symbol and bind each to an input with data-testid `target-input-${symbol}`
On save, send edited targets and budget, then refresh `planRefresh` by refetching the plan so the rows reflect the new values, and show a 'Saved' notice (data-testid 'applied')

sessions.title: Apply plan and reconcile
sessions.goal: Apply the proposed plan to holdings, write trades, refresh and show reduced drift.

criteria.check: POST /api/apply-plan returns 200 with a JSON body that includes an 'applied' count greater than 0
After clicking Apply Plan, sc-dashboard refreshes and shows a visible notice (data-testid 'applied')
GET /api/trades returns 200 with a JSON array of Trade objects that include symbol and shares
After applying, the average absolute drift from GET /api/allocation is lower than before applying
POST /api/apply-plan returns 200 with a JSON body that includes updatedHoldings whose length equals the number of assets

cuts.hint: Compute the current plan, apply it, write `{ applied, updatedHoldings }` into `body` and set `status` to 200
Build `updatedHoldings` by applying each TradeItem's integer shares to the corresponding Holding and persisting the new share counts
On click of the apply button, call the apply endpoint, refresh the positions/allocation, set `afterState` so the notice (data-testid 'applied') is visible, and re-render the tables
Insert one Trade per plan item and set `created` to the number inserted
Put every recorded Trade into `body` and set `status` to 200
